description: This file contains test functions for the Shape data structure in the TensorFlow Go API. It defines unit tests for shape creation, conversion to slices, string representation, and handling of unknown shapes.

methods.name: TestShape
methods.description: Test function for various Shape behaviors including dimension count, slice conversion, full specification, and string representation.

methods.name: TestZeroShape
methods.description: Test function for behavior of an uninitialized Shape, including error conditions and string output.
